'''Ironwood trees''' are trees that may be grown with the [[Farming]] [[skill]]. Level 80 farmers may grow an ironwood tree by planting an [[ironwood sapling]] in a [[hardwood tree patch]] using a [[spade]]. When planted, the nearby farmer will watch over a growing ironwood tree in exchange for 10 [[Curry leaf|curry leaves]], which may be noted.

An ironwood tree sapling will take 8 hardwood [[growth tick|growth ticks]] (at most 5,120 minutes or approximately 3 days, 13 hours, and 20 minutes) to grow to maturity. Once mature, the tree grows into an [[ironwood tree]] which can be harvested for [[ironwood logs]].

Checking the health of an ironwood tree grants 20,425 Farming experience. If buying the [[ironwood seed]] and [[curry leaf]] on the [[Grand Exchange]], it will cost around {{Coins|{{GEP|Ironwood seed}}+{{GEP|Curry leaf|10}}}} per tree, assuming one pays a gardener.

To reduce the effectiveness of tick manipulation, ironwood trees in hardwood patches do not follow the 4 minute depletion cycle regular ironwood trees have and may deplete much earlier. Additionally, they respawn after 2 minutes.{{CiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/sailing---resources--skilling-activities-poll?oldschool=1|title=Sailing - Resources & Skilling Activities Poll|newsdate=31 July 2025|quote=Hardwood tree patch variants respawn slower to reduce effectiveness of 1.5t methods.}}
